# Jim Tsipoutas

> Jim Tsipoutas (Dimitris Tsipoutas) is Head of Product Design & UX, based in Athens, Greece, with 20+ years across digital products, UX, visual design and design systems. He pairs design leadership with hands-on craftsmanship — framing, designing and building intelligent products alongside teams.

## What he does
Product direction, interface systems and AI-first products: the framing that decides what to build, the design system that keeps it coherent, and the engineering that gets it shipped. Leadership by building rather than by slide deck.

- Product direction and framing.
- Interface systems and design principles at scale.
- AI-first products, designed and built end to end.
- Design leadership embedded with teams.

## Available for
Design leadership, consulting and fractional work with teams building intelligent products.

## Work
Founder of [The Last Click](https://thelastclick.gr), where the products live: Padlboard (padel scoring for Apple Watch and iPhone), BoomBoats (a voxel iPhone game), Cookonomics (food costing) and FlexUI (an API-driven design system for AI coding tools).

## Contact
hello@jimtsipoutas.com — the contact form on the site reaches the same inbox.
